title: Properties of a fixed all-stage closed direct-image presentation
statement: Under the same field, coefficient, scheme, and closed-immersion hypotheses, every fixed compatible presentation $S$ of the finite, integral, rational, and algebraically closed direct images has fully faithful restriction functors at every coefficient stage; every right-adjoint unit on the restricted stages is an isomorphism; and the ambient finite-coefficient right adjoint exists with invertible unit.

proof.text: Construct the requested compatible restrictions by the closed-support, recollement, coefficient-comparison, scalar-localization, and common-stage arguments of the parent proof. The corresponding Hom maps are bijective and the adjunction-unit assertion follows by Yoneda.
